Both were byte-identically copied on 2026-07-06 per Ledger #265 (vendorn + comdare:: alias, NO live FetchContent) — NOT submodules, NOT FetchContent. Provenance is in vendor/REPOS_OVERVIEW.md (comdare-platform SHA 511fca57, comdare-simd SHA 7f0039f from gitlab.comdare.de/comdare/modules/comdare-foundation/*). Both expose CMake INTERFACE (header-only) targets with comdare::platform / comdare::simd aliases in namespaces ::comdare::platform / ::comdare::simd (Foundation Host-truth infra, deliberately distinct from the cache-engine's own comdare::cache_engine::platform model-layer and the comdare::cache_engine::simd axis_09). comdare-platform IS consumed by ce code (cpuid_platform_probe.hpp includes comdare/platform/SIMDDetect.hpp, linked via cache_engine_commands_v32); comdare-simd is only CMake-wired into the isa_dispatch skeleton with NO C++ consumer yet (axis_09 is the D2-authoritative consumer, not yet wired). result.summary:
The cache-engine documents ONE large set of tier-binary CONSTRUCTION axes and ONE small orthogonal MEASUREMENT/observer system; both flow into each compiled Tier-Binary ("Lebewesen").

(1) TIER-BINARY-KONSTRUKTIONS-ACHSEN (construction). Source: composition_factory.hpp:20-93 (AdHocComposition, static_assert sizeof...(Vs)==19) + thesis tab:axes-overview (03_messsystem_prtart.tex:57-135) + doc 30 §6/§8. A tier-binary is a compile-time composition over 19 Kompositions-Achsen T0..T18 PLUS 3 Build-Achsen (page_type, simd_extension, general_hardware) = 22 total (doc 30 Befund 1 lines 14-31; "22" = 19 SA-composition + 3 build after the queuing merge). The 19: T0 search_algo, T1 cache_traversal, T2 mapping, T3 path_compression, T4 node_type, T5 memory_layout, T6 allocator, T7 prefetch, T8 concurrency, T9 serialization, T10 telemetry, T11 value_handle, T12 isa, T13 index_organization, T14 io_dispatch, T15 migration_policy, T16 filter, T17 queuing_q1, T18 queuing_q2. Each axis is a topic dir libs/cache_engine/topics/<topic>/axis_NN_* (search_algo=topics/traversal/axis_03a_search_algo, node_type=topics/nodes/axis_04_node_type, allocator=topics/allocator/axis_06_allocator, queuing=topics/queuing/axis_q1|axis_q2, build page_type=topics/nodes/axis_01_page_type, simd=topics/hardware/axis_09b_simd_extension, hw=topics/hardware/axis_12_general_hardware). Axis T0 (axis_03a) carries the tree/btree/art/skip/hash/masstree/surf/wormhole variants (axis_03a_search_algo/*.hpp + composable/composed_{tree,btree,art_trie,skip_list,hash,masstree,surf_map,wormhole,hot_patricia,start_trie}_search.hpp). Honest IST/SOLL caveat (doc 30 Befund 2 + §6 + §8.2): search organs historically bypassed the storage axes; storage delegation fixed via NodeChunkedStore (node_type now runtime-effective); full search-organ delegation + memory_layout-for-node-pools remain open.

(2) SYSTEM-MESSACHSEN / Observer-Mess-System (measurement). Source: doc 24 (§2, §8 hybrid), observable_tier.hpp:45-101, measurable_workload.hpp:97-99, messarchitektur_v5_drei_profile.md, thesis 03_messsystem:383. NOT a disjoint set of tree-axes; a small fixed measurement dimension LAYERED ON the same 19 construction axes - every organ exposes statistics() that measures cache-line behaviour AT that structural point. Pieces: (a) per-Achsen Observer statistics() aggregated via observe_all() -> ObserverAggregate, pulled across the ABI as flat POD ComdareTierObserverSnapshot axis_stats[19][8] (T5 field cache_lines, T6 allocator bytes/alloc_cnt, T0 lookup/hit/miss/insert/erase/peak); (b) Lebewesen-Wall-Clock: seg_ns[19] per-organ segment latency + fill-level curves split read/write/delete + RAM/disk, driven centrally by CacheEngineBuilder (doc 24 §2.1); (c) PMC/hardware-counter categories (Domain 3 Measurement, libs/common/measurement; perf/PAPI/HdrHistogram/Advisor) - Cache-Line-Auslastung, Cache-Misses, dTLB-Misses, Speicher-Fussabdruck, Branch-Misses, IPC/CPI, Latenz, Durchsatz, Energie (thesis :383); (d) two orthogonal EXPERIMENT axes Build-Profil vs Lastenprofil ("die zwei Haupt-Experiment-Achsen"), with COMDARE_MEASUREMENT_MODE a compile switch (Compile-Release-Profil, not an axis). doc 24 §8 = HYBRID: Pfad A (isolated axis comparison IN the DLL via IMeasurableWorkload::run_workload) vs Pfad B (composite Lebewesen host-side via Pruef-Dock reading IObservableTier).

Composition into a tier-binary: apps/adhoc_emitter enumerates the permutation space -> CMake builds each permutation as SHARED .dll/.so via COMDARE_DEFINE_ANATOMY_MODULE_ADHOC_BUILDVARIANT(page_type, simd_extension, general_hardware, <19 composition axes>) (include/cache_engine/abi/anatomy_module_abi_v1.hpp) -> AdHocComposition<19> in SearchAlgorithmAnatomy (the Tier). If COMDARE_MEASUREMENT_MODE=ON the binary ALSO carries the measurement system (per-axis observers + IObservableTier + IMeasurableWorkload); the per-Gattung Pruef-Dock (SearchAlgorithm/Container/Graph, anatomy_base.hpp:32-71) loads it, drives the genus API, and pulls correlated (wall-clock, observer) results. Construction axes SHAPE the binary; measurement observers READ it at each structural axis-point, gated by the Compile-Release-Profil.

axis_systems.name: Tier-Binary-Konstruktions-Achsen (19 Kompositions-Achsen T0-T18 + 3 Build-Achsen)
axis_systems.role: Compile-time axes that SHAPE the Tier-Binary. A tier-binary is a metaprogrammed composition (AdHocComposition<19>, static_assert==19) over 19 exchangeable organ-axes plus 3 build-variant axes = 22 total. Each axis is a topic dir libs/cache_engine/topics/<topic>/axis_NN_* with a registry of swappable organ-algorithms; a non-participating axis picks an explicit pass-through algorithm (NoBuffer/NonePrefetch) - never optional. Assembled per-permutation into a SHARED .dll/.so via COMDARE_DEFINE_ANATOMY_MODULE_ADHOC_BUILDVARIANT.

axis_systems.name: System-Messachsen / Observer-Mess-System (Achsen-Observer + Lebewesen-Wall-Clock + PMC)
axis_systems.role: The small fixed measurement dimension that READS cache-line behaviour AT each structural axis-point. Orthogonal to construction: layered ON the same 19 construction axes (each organ exposes statistics()), not a separate set of tree-axes. Compiled in only when COMDARE_MEASUREMENT_MODE=ON (Compile-Release-Profil); the per-Gattung Pruef-Dock loads the binary, drives the genus API, pulls correlated (wall-clock, observer) results. doc 24 §8 hybrid: Pfad A (isolated axis comparison IN the DLL via IMeasurableWorkload) vs Pfad B (composite Lebewesen host-side via IObservableTier).
axes: Achsen-Observer (per-organ statistics()) - observe_all() -> ObserverAggregate -> flat ABI POD ComdareTierObserverSnapshot axis_stats[19][8] (observable_tier.hpp:45-101; T5 field cache_lines, T6 bytes/alloc_cnt, T0 lookup/hit/miss/insert/erase/peak) - measures at each of the 19 axis points

Lebewesen-Wall-Clock (whole-algorithm) - seg_ns[19] per-organ segment latency (measurable_workload.hpp:97-99) + fill-level latency curves split read/write/delete + RAM/disk, driven centrally by CacheEngineBuilder (doc 24 §2.1)

PMC/Hardware-Counter categories (Domain 3 Measurement, libs/common/measurement; perf/PAPI/HdrHistogram/Advisor) - Cache-Line-Auslastung, Cache-Misses, dTLB-Misses, Speicher-Fussabdruck, Branch-Misses, IPC/CPI, Latenz, Durchsatz, Energie (thesis 03_messsystem:383)
Achsen-Vergleich (correctness dimension) - per-axis unit/property tests vs unified axis interface vs known algorithms std::map (doc 24 §2.3)

Experiment-Achsen: Build-Profil vs Lastenprofil - the two orthogonal main experiment axes of the cartesian F15 cross (messarchitektur_v5_drei_profile.md); Compile-Release-Profil (COMDARE_MEASUREMENT_MODE) is a switch, NOT a third axis

modules.name: AdHocComposition / composition_factory
modules.role: Compile-time integration point: materializes a PermTuple of 19 axis-organ types into a named 19-axis Composition; static_assert==19. How construction axes compose into a tier-binary.
modules.integration_mechanism: variadic template AdHocComposition<19> wrapped by SearchAlgorithmAnatomy

modules.name: COMDARE_DEFINE_ANATOMY_MODULE_ADHOC_BUILDVARIANT macro
modules.role: Emits one loadable SHARED tier-binary from build args (page_type PT, simd_extension SE, general_hardware HW) + the 19 composition-axis organ types. Binds the 3 build-axes to the 19 composition-axes into one .dll/.so.
modules.integration_mechanism: preprocessor macro -> AdHocComposition + SearchAlgorithmAnatomy + ABI factory export

modules.name: axis_03a_search_algo (T0 search axis)
modules.role: The search-algorithm construction axis; holds the tree/btree/art/skip/hash/masstree/surf/wormhole organ variants (monolith *.hpp + composable/ traversal organs delegating to node/layout/allocator stores).

modules.name: topics/<topic>/axis_NN_* (all 19 composition + 3 build axes)
modules.role: Directory home of every construction axis (one topic dir per axis + concepts/); each provides a registry of swappable organ-algorithms behind a unified axis interface.

modules.name: IObservableTier + ComdareTierObserverSnapshot POD
modules.role: ABI-stable observer sub-interface carrying per-axis statistics() as a flat POD axis_stats[19][8] across the module-binary boundary (Pfad B). The measurement system cross-ABI transport.
modules.integration_mechanism: dynamic_cast<IObservableTier*> on loaded module; memcpy-able trivially_copyable POD

modules.name: ObserverAggregate / observe_all()
modules.role: Aggregates each of the 19 axis organs statistics() snapshots into one per-tier statistics trace (doc 24 §2.2); measures at every axis point.

modules.name: IMeasurableWorkload::run_workload (seg_ns[19])
modules.role: Pfad A of the hybrid: isolated per-axis / whole-tier wall-clock measured INSIDE the DLL; seg_ns[19] holds per-organ segment latency.

modules.name: Pruef-Dock (per-Gattung ABI measurement bridge)
modules.role: CacheEngineBuilder side per genus (SearchAlgorithm|Container|Graph) that loads a tier-binary, drives its genus API, measures built-in observers, persists correlated (wall-clock, observer) results. Where the two systems meet on a compiled binary.

modules.name: Measurement subsystem (Domain 3)
modules.role: Low-level measurement mechanics: In-Memory MeasurementBuffer, perf/PAPI/Advisor/HdrHistogram wrappers, microbenchmarks; provides PMC metric categories (cache-lines, cache-misses, dTLB, branch-misses, IPC/CPI, latency, throughput, energy).

modules.name: adhoc_emitter + comdare_build_adhoc_modules
modules.role: Enumerates the permutation space of construction axes and drives CMake to build each permutation as a separate loadable tier-binary (doc 24 §8.3).
